insights.one_liner: Amsterdam AI and transformation consultancy of about 48 people, founded in 2018, backed by a network of freelance experts; a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: A small consultancy of about 48 people in Amsterdam, mixing strategy work, training and AI-augmented workflows for large clients.
Staff often come from the University of Amsterdam, Groningen, RSM Erasmus, VU Amsterdam and Nyenrode, mostly in business, economics and mathematics.
Works with a global network of independent experts ('PROs') in technology, data and change alongside its own team.
